verdict.rationale: Ashby describes itself as an all-in-one platform that combines ATS, scheduling and CRM in one tool, and its record set spans candidates, interviews, notes, feedback and emails. That suggests candidate data lives in one system, but no evidence describes a single unified candidate profile bringing these elements together. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a unified candidate profile/record view, resume storage on the profile, activity history timeline, consent status tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, every candidate has one unified profile — resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history, and consent status in a single record

citations.quote: Ashby's All-in-One Recruiting platform combines your ATS, Scheduling, CRM & Sourcing, and Analytics into one powerful tool.
Search and retrieve recruiting context across candidates, applications, jobs, job postings, interviews, offers, notes, feedback, emails, referrals, hiring teams, and other recruiting records.
